title: Cytotoxic and proapoptotic effects of alizarin in mice with Ehrlich solid tumor: novel insights into ERalpha-mediated MDM2/p-Rb/E2F1 signaling pathway.
authors: Eid, Aya H; Al-Karmalawy, Ahmed A; Abdelhameed, Reda F A; Mostafa, Yasser M; Helal, Gouda K; Mehanna, Eman T; Hazem, Reem M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究茜素在小鼠实体瘤中的细胞毒与促凋亡作用，涉及ERalpha介导信号通路及分子对接，但核心是药物抗肿瘤机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The role of estrogen receptor (ER) and its related effects is crucial for growth of breast cancer cells. This study aimed to assess the cytotoxic impact of alizarin in models of breast cancer in vivo and investigate its antiestrogenic and apoptotic properties. MTT assay was used to evaluate alizarin cytotoxic effect against MCF7 and MDA-MB-231. In vivo, 30 mice were insulted with Ehrlich tumor cells. They were randomly allocated into 3 groups, 10 mice each. Alizarin was orally administered to two treatment groups (50 mg/kg and 100 mg/kg), respectively. The third group was considered as a positive control group. Western blot was used to evaluate the expression of mouse double minute 2 (MDM2), phosphorylated retinoblastoma (pRb), and E2F1. Caspase threefold change was measured by RT-PCR. ERalpha, Bax, and p53 expressions were investigated by immunohistochemistry. Molecular docking study of alizarin effect on ER was performed. Alizarin demonstrated dose dependent cytotoxicity against MCF7 and MDA-MB cell lines. Alizarin decreased tumor weight in mice, prompted cell cycle arrest, and stimulated cell apoptosis by impeding ERalpha-mediated tumorigenic effects, and inactivating its related MDM2/p-Rb/E2F1 signaling cascade with upregulation of target genes involved in cell apoptosis (Bax, caspase 3, and p53). Molecular docking proposed that alizarin is a very promising inhibitor to ER. Alizarin represented a promising approach to inhibit cell proliferation of breast cancer by modulating estrogen receptor mediated effects on MDM2/p-Rb/E2F1 axis concomitantly with activating apoptosis of cancer cells.
abstract_zh: 雌激素受体（estrogen receptor, ER）及其相关效应在乳腺癌细胞生长中至关重要。本研究旨在评估茜素（alizarin）在体内乳腺癌模型中的细胞毒性作用，并探讨其抗雌激素及凋亡特性。采用MTT法评估茜素对MCF7和MDA-MB-231的细胞毒性效应。体内实验中，30只小鼠接种艾氏肿瘤细胞（Ehrlich tumor cells），随机分为3组，每组10只。两个治疗组分别口服给予茜素（50 mg/kg和100 mg/kg），第三组作为阳性对照组。通过Western blot评估小鼠双微体2（mouse double minute 2, MDM2）、磷酸化视网膜母细胞瘤蛋白（phosphorylated retinoblastoma, pRb）及E2F1的表达。采用RT-PCR测量caspase的三倍变化。通过免疫组织化学检测ERα、Bax和p53的表达。对茜素作用于ER的分子对接研究进行了分析。茜素对MCF7和MDA-MB细胞系表现出剂量依赖性细胞毒性。茜素降低了小鼠肿瘤重量，促进细胞周期阻滞，并通过抑制ERα介导的致瘤效应及失活其相关MDM2/p-Rb/E2F1信号级联，同时上调参与细胞凋亡的靶基因（Bax、caspase 3和p53）表达，从而刺激细胞凋亡。分子对接提示茜素是ER的一种极具前景的抑制剂。茜素通过调节雌激素受体介导的MDM2/p-Rb/E2F1轴效应，并伴随激活癌细胞凋亡，代表了一种抑制乳腺癌细胞增殖的有前景的方法。
